name: Consolidated Acts of the Northwest Territories
label: Northwest Territories
record_note: The baseline records 238 current consolidations. Délîne Final Self-Government Agreement Act also records section 5-only commencement on 2015-03-12 and complete commencement on 2016-09-01 in appended correction snapshots. All current law files retain the published baseline bytes. The Délîne additions were checked against the certified Act and official consolidation on 2026-11-05; the baseline checked_on date is unchanged.

dates.commit: in-force day of the consolidated text: the CreationDate of the Act's consolidation PDF, or the latest in-force day its AMENDED BY list gives when that is later; appended historical commencement snapshots use the legal dates printed by the source
dates.time: 12:00 America/Yellowknife (UTC-7; UTC-6 in daylight time, hard-coded Canadian rules)

author.consolidated: Legislation Division, Department of Justice (Government of the Northwest Territories)
author.unexplained: Legislation Division, Department of Justice (Government of the Northwest Territories)

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: presumption against retrospectivity; effect of repeal saved by the Interpretation Act
default_reach.meaning: an enactment is presumed not to apply to facts completed before it came into force, or to interfere with vested rights, unless the Legislature says so expressly or by necessary implication; a repeal does not affect rights acquired, or proceedings begun, under the repealed enactment
default_reach.authority: Interpretation Act, RSNWT 1988, c. I-8 (effect of repeal); R. v. Dineley, 2012 SCC 58, [2012] 3 S.C.R. 272

path_pattern: acts/<official PDF stem>/s-<section, whole part padded to 3 digits>.md; acts/<stem>/schedule-<label>.md; acts/<stem>/intro.md; acts/<stem>/title.md
history_coverage: Partial: current consolidation baselines for 238 Acts; two Délîne commencement snapshots.
